description: Subdomain takeover check — Live subdomain-takeover scan: resolves a domain's common subdomains (or your own hosts= list, up to 30) over DNS-over-HTTPS, follows CNAME chains, flags dangling records (target NXDOMAIN, unregistered target domain) and fetches hosts on ~35 hosting services (S3, GitHub Pages, Heroku, Azure, Shopify, Netlify, Vercel, Zendesk...) to match unclaimed-resource fingerprints. Params: domain (or hosts=a.x.com,b.x.com), extra= more subdomain prefixes. Returns VULNERABLE / REVIEW / CLEAN with per-host reasons. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_takeover_check
